description: A lone identifier IS valid code, so it is checked as code — and as a statement it has no effect: E-STMT-NO-EFFECT (ruling S445 item 2; was E-SCOPE-001 under S441 (3)), not E-UNQUOTED-DISPLAY-TEXT.
rationale: §40.8: a `<program>` / `<page>` / `<channel>` body is a code-default body — a bare run there is code. Ruling user-voice-scrml.md S445 item 2: "Any expression statement with no effect is an error." A lone name is valid code with no effect, reported as that.
